comment: Figure 3: canonical C2CD mimotope LRAGRSRRL activates the explicitly expressed receptor in SKW3 cells against peptide-pulsed HLA-C*06:02 targets. Complete receptor junctions are confirmed by deposited 8SHI polymer sequences; J calls are not explicitly reported here. Cross-paper parent provenance: PMID38524140 Supplementary Table S1 explicitly identifies LRAGRSRRL as human C2CD4B residues 193-201, and the original psoriasis study PMC4689169 confirms cloning C2CD4B from human 1205Lu cDNA. This paper calls the peptide C2CD; the exact gene attribution is supplied by those primary sources. The PDB complex and ADAMTSL5 variant assays use aminobutyric acid, marked bold-italic C in source XML, and are not assigned to this conventional peptide.
